The '''Bandos chestplate''' is a part of the [[Bandos armour]] set, which requires 65 [[Defence]] to wear. It is dropped by [[General Graardor]] and his bodyguards in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. The Bandos chestplate provides a +4 [[Strength#Strength bonus|Strength bonus]], and more defensive bonuses than comparable body armours such as the [[fighter torso]] and [[inquisitor's hauberk]]. Despite seemingly being made of metal, the Bandos chestplate does not interfere with [[Ava's devices]].
